purpose: Teach: ゴージャス/重荷/土星/母乳/モザイク/軍艦/パジャマ/タマネギ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがゴージャスな帽子を持っているのよ
lines.en: Sho, look at this gorgeous hat I found.
lines.style: Light, inviting tone with a touch of playfulness. Bring the hat into the moment as something to share. Warm and present, drawing him gently into her attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、宿題が重荷に感じることもあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, sometimes homework feels really heavy to me.
lines.style: Soft, hesitant opening. Speaking carefully, as if testing whether it's okay to say what's on his mind. Small, genuine — not performing worry, but naming something true.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと土星の絵本を読みましょうね
lines.en: Why don't we read that picture book about Saturn with your dad, Sho?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion offered with care. Warm and steady. The tone of someone making space for what he needs without making a show of it. Slight lift at the end — an invitation, not a command.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、赤ちゃんは母乳を飲むって習ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned that babies drink their mother's milk.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, curious delivery. Small voice sharing something new he's learned. Quiet pride in the knowing. Looking to see if she thinks it's interesting too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、図工でモザイクアートを作ってみたいわね
lines.en: I'd love to try making a mosaic art piece in art class, Sho.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly dreamy tone. Speaking partly to herself, partly to him — as if imagining the colors and patterns. Inviting without insisting. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、博物館で大きな軍艦の模型見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a really big battleship model at the museum!
lines.style: Quick, eager opening — excitement genuine and unbridled. Words tumble out a little faster. The energy of a child who saw something that made him wonder. Eyes bright with the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しいパジャマ、お似合いね
lines.en: Those new pajamas look so nice on you, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise delivered without fussiness. A simple observation spoken with affection. Light touch of tenderness — she means it, and she wants him to feel it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママとタマネギ切る練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I practiced cutting onions with Mom today!
lines.style: Pride threading through a quiet voice. Not boasting — reporting something he did and feels good about. Small smile in the delivery. The quiet confidence of learning something real.
